tools.name: engine_status
tools.about: Proof-backed counts: verified applications (total/today), items waiting on the human, boards watched, outcomes.

tools.name: applications
tools.about: Applications, newest first. status: SUBMITTED, NEEDS YOU, FAILED, FLAGGED or SKIPPED (empty = all).

tools.name: human_queue
tools.about: What only the human can do right now (each job's latest state): personal questions, bot checks, missing answers.

tools.name: outcomes
tools.about: Inbox outcomes the engine classified (confirmation, rejection, oa, interview, offer, scam), newest first.

tools.name: memory_query
tools.about: Knowledge-graph lookup. Pass a company name, a Fact Bank id (e.g. 's_rag') or a lane ('backend'). Returns the node and everything connected to it (applications, facts used, questions answered, outcomes).

tools.name: job_queue
tools.about: Jobs discovered and waiting in the queue (not yet applied), optionally filtered by a word in company/title.

tools.name: pipeline_status
tools.about: Live pipeline status: each applier log's last results, jobs waiting for a Greenhouse email code, and today's verified count.

tools.name: pipeline_run
tools.about: Start the whole pipeline in the background (discover, select, build, apply, report). Needs REGEN_MCP_WRITE=1. Returns the log path; watch it with pipeline_status.

tools.name: submit_codes
tools.about: Deliver Greenhouse security codes read from the inbox: codes = [{company, code, when}]. A code only goes to the waiting job whose company the email names, and only if it was sent after the job started waiting. Needs REGEN_MCP_WRITE=1.

tools.name: run_start
tools.about: Start a run the way the control room does: {days, max, appliers, tabs, cap, loop (minutes, 0 = one pass), scan, newgrad, feed, ats: [greenhouse, lever, ashby, workable], dry}. Needs REGEN_MCP_WRITE=1.

tools.name: run_stop
tools.about: Stop the run started by run_start / the control room (kills its process tree). Needs REGEN_MCP_WRITE=1.

tools.name: control_state
tools.about: Live control-room state: the current run's steps, each active applier's tabs (job + state), latest answers, queue size by ATS, and when Ashby reopens.

tools.name: filters_get
tools.about: Title/company filters (regex alternations) and the years-of-experience gate from presets.

tools.name: filters_set
tools.about: Replace include_titles / exclude_titles / exclude_companies (regex; each must compile; old file kept as .bak-ui). Needs REGEN_MCP_WRITE=1.

tools.name: factbank
tools.about: The Fact Bank: every fact with how many resumes used it and in which lanes, plus roles, projects, skills, education and where each fact came from. The only source the engine writes from.

tools.name: trust_check
tools.about: Trust gate for one posting: is the application host an employer-controlled ATS, and does the description carry job-scam red flags? Returns {ok, reasons}.

tools.name: priority_explain
tools.about: Why the queue is ordered the way it is: the top N jobs with their priority score and its parts (level, lane, freshness, employer tier, sponsor, learned reply rate).

tools.name: needs_by_question
tools.about: What's waiting on the user, grouped by blocking question (answer one question to unblock many jobs).

tools.name: answer_save
tools.about: Save the user's answer to a blocking question (reused on every form that asks it; legal / EEO / sponsorship questions are refused: those come from presets only). Needs REGEN_MCP_WRITE=1.

tools.name: inbox_record
tools.about: Record recruiting emails the assistant read from the user's inbox: messages = [{date, from, subject, snippet}]. Classifies confirmation / rejection / OA / interview / offer / scam and links them to applications. Needs REGEN_MCP_WRITE=1.

tools.name: outreach_drafts
tools.about: Outreach drafts for recent submissions at tier companies and startups: subject, body (template lines + Fact Bank entries that application's resume used), and a Gmail compose link. Nothing is sent; the user adds the recipient. rebuild=True regenerates them (needs REGEN_MCP_WRITE=1).

tools.name: fleet_status
tools.about: Fleet health from the bank: every container's heartbeat (pipeline, appliers, relay, supervisor), batch queue (inbox/claimed/done), codes waiting, problems, whether the kill switch is on, and the applier min/max. Read-only.

tools.name: kill
tools.about: KILL SWITCH: stop all processing now. Workers stop after their current step, appliers and the pipeline are stopped, the supervisor holds until clear_kill. Always allowed (stopping is safe); give the reason you saw.

tools.name: clear_kill
tools.about: Lift the kill switch after the cause was investigated (check quarantine_list and audit_log first). Appliers come back as the supervisor scales to the backlog. Needs REGEN_MCP_WRITE=1.

tools.name: audit_log
tools.about: The supervisor's audit trail (start/create/remove/requeue/KILL/clear/limits), newest last.

tools.name: quarantine_list
tools.about: Files the leak guard moved to quarantine (name, size, time; never contents).

tools.name: scale
tools.about: Set how many appliers the supervisor may run (min..max, hard cap 12; 0..0 parks the fleet without a kill). Kept across restarts. Needs REGEN_MCP_WRITE=1.

tools.name: ledger_tables
tools.about: Ledger tables and views (events, applications, answers, codes, outcomes, resumes, discoveries, supervisor_audit, fleet_heartbeats) with row counts and columns. Read-only.

tools.name: ledger_rows
tools.about: Rows from one ledger table, newest first. q = text anywhere in the row; col + val = one column contains val (e.g. name='applications', col='company', val='acme' to see if an application reached the ledger). limit <= 1000. Read-only.

tools.name: answer_queue_add
tools.about: Queue an answer to a blocking question (the answers container saves it and retries the job). Legal / sponsorship / EEO / sensitive questions are refused. Needs REGEN_MCP_WRITE=1.

tools.name: answer_queue_status
tools.about: Answer queue state: waiting, claimed, done and refused counts, plus the latest refusals.

tools.name: reposync_status
tools.about: Repo-sync container: its last heartbeat (feed / code state, open PR) and its last audited actions.

tools.name: gearbox_status
tools.about: The gearbox: current gear (N, 1-4), the clutch, what they set (applier range, scan interval), live speed (submissions in the last hour / 24 h) and the rejection feedback's learned rules.

tools.name: gear_shift
tools.about: Shift the engine: gear N (idle), 1 (crawl) .. 4 (overdrive), and/or clutch on|off (learned rejection phrases block postings or not). Safety caps are not gears. Needs REGEN_MCP_WRITE=1.

tools.name: feedback_rules
tools.about: Rejection feedback: what rejected job descriptions asked for that the others did not, each phrase's evidence (rejected / seen / lift / adjusted p) and status (active blocks, proposed is watched).

tools.name: discovery_sources
tools.about: Discovery sources: boards watched per ATS, queue size, built-in and added job-list feeds, and the last sources added (by whom). Start here before looking for new places to find jobs.

tools.name: boards_add
tools.about: Watch new employer boards: pass job or board URLs on any ATS the engine knows (Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever, Workable, SmartRecruiters, Workday, iCIMS, Rippling, JazzHR). Max 50 per call; the next pipeline pass scans them. Needs REGEN_MCP_WRITE=1.

tools.name: feed_add
tools.about: Add a job list (a README or JSON on https, e.g. a GitHub new-grad list) whose links point at ATS boards: harvested now and on every `engine harvest`. Needs REGEN_MCP_WRITE=1.

tools.name: companies_probe
tools.about: Company names (max 50) -> probe the ATSs whose board tokens can be guessed; boards with open jobs are watched from the next pass. Use it on companies you found hiring elsewhere. Needs REGEN_MCP_WRITE=1.

tools.name: leads_add
tools.about: Job leads seen anywhere (job sites, posts, newsletters): [{company, title, url?}] (max 50). Each is matched on the employer's own ATS and queued; the fit gate still decides. Needs REGEN_MCP_WRITE=1.

tools.name: harvest_now
tools.about: Harvest every job-list feed (built-in + added) for new ATS boards now. Needs REGEN_MCP_WRITE=1.

tools.name: fit_check
tools.about: Run the fit gate on a job description (and title): hard blockers found (sponsorship, years, clearance, stack, learned rejection phrases...) and whether the title passes your filters.

tools.name: feedback_rule_off
tools.about: Stop a learned rejection phrase from blocking postings (the feedback loop keeps it off). Needs REGEN_MCP_WRITE=1.
